title: A performance refactor of AdminPermission.projects split one combined Q filter into chained .filter(teams__members=user).filter(teams__access=ADMIN_ACCESS) calls, so read-only team members get admin rights on any project that also belongs to some admin team.

findings.explanation: The change only manipulates Django ORM QuerySets using Q objects and filter/exclude calls. No raw SQL strings are constructed from user input, so there is no risk of SQL injection.

The modification replaces chained filters on related models with a single filter using a combined Q object, which correctly enforces that the user must both be a team member and have the required access level. This removes a previously noted authorization weakness and does not introduce a new one.
